It uses Rust\n1.97.0 and the standard library only: no external crates, no serde, no HTTP\nframework. HTTP is implemented directly on `std::net::TcpListener` /\n`TcpStream`, and JSON is built and parsed with string manipulation.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nPORT=8080 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` removes the local database (`game.db`), builds the server with\n`cargo run`, and starts it in the foreground. The server binds to `127.0.0.1`\non the port given by the `PORT` environment variable (default `8080`). The\ndatabase path can be overridden with `DB_PATH`.\n\nVerify the server is listening:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n# => {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nReset the database and in-memory caches (registered user accounts are\npreserved so the authenticated play surface remains usable):\n\n```bash\ncurl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/storage/reset\n# => {\"ok\":true,\"schema_version\":1}\n```\n\n## Entry point and module layout\n\n- `Cargo.toml` — package metadata. No external dependencies.\n- `run.sh` — builds and runs the server with `cargo run`.\n- `src/main.rs` — entry point, module declarations, global state, and the\n  central request dispatcher. Routing is split into `dispatch_get`,\n  `dispatch_post`, and `dispatch_put` helpers.\n- `src/domain.rs` — core domain types (`Combatant`, `CombatSession`, `User`,\n  `Condition`) and the global in-memory caches (`SESSIONS`, `USERS`).\n- `src/http.rs` — minimal HTTP/1.1 request parsing and response writing.\n- `src/json.rs` — hand-rolled JSON parsing helpers used by every handler.\n- `src/store.rs` — SQLite persistence via the `sqlite3` CLI tool, plus all\n  existence and lookup helpers used by the domain modules.\n- `src/auth.rs` — registration, login, and bearer-token state\n\nTwo global `LazyLock<Mutex<HashMap<...>>>` caches live in `src/domain.rs`:\n\n- `SESSIONS` — `HashMap<String, CombatSession>` for active combat encounters.\n- `USERS` — `HashMap<String, User>` for registered accounts.\n\nThese caches are locked at the start of every request in `dispatch_request` and\nheld until the response is written. This serializes requests and keeps the\nin-memory view consistent with the database between `save_storage` calls.\n\n### Persistence\n\nPersistence is implemented in `src/store.rs` by invoking the `sqlite3` command\nline tool. The schema is created by `init_db()` on startup if it does not exist.\n\nMutable state is saved with a simple “delete all, then re-insert all” strategy:\n`save_storage` deletes every row from `users`, `combat_sessions`, `combatants`,\nand `conditions`, then re-inserts the current contents of `SESSIONS` and\n`USERS`. This is intentionally simple and deterministic. The database is loaded\nonce at startup by `load_storage`.\n\nOther tables (`campaigns`, `characters`, `events`, `monsters`, `items`,\n`monster_tags`, `quests`, `quest_milestones`, `factions`, `npcs`,\n`campaign_inventory`, `character_equipment`, `crafting_projects`,\n`campaign_sessions`, `session_agenda`, `session_attendance`, `play_campaigns`,\n`play_campaign_members`, `play_narrations`, `play_campaign_documents`) are\nwritten directly by their respective handlers and do not go through the\nin-memory caches. After a handler that mutates `SESSIONS` or\n`USERS` succeeds, the dispatcher calls `save_storage` to persist the change.\n\n### JSON parsing\n\n`src/json.rs` provides a small, serde-free parser. It scans for `\"key\"`, finds\nthe following `:`, and extracts the next primitive value or bracketed/array\nblock. It supports nested objects and arrays by tracking `{ }` / `[ ]` depth,\nbut does not handle escaped quotes inside string values. fails, the database is\n/// reported as uninitialized with version 0.\npub fn storage_status() -> Result<(i64, bool), String> {\n    let sql = \"SELECT version, initialized FROM schema_meta WHERE version = 1;\";\n    match sqlite_query(sql) {\n        Ok(output) => {\n            let content = extract_top_array_content(&output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n            let objects = extract_objects(content);\n            if objects.is_empty() {\n                return Ok((0, false));\n            }\n            let obj = objects[0];\n            let version = extract_int(obj, \"version\").unwrap_or(0);\n            let initialized = extract_int(obj, \"initialized\").unwrap_or(0) != 0;\n            Ok((version, initialized))\n        }\n        Err(_) => Ok((0, false)),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Load persistent users and combat sessions from SQLite into the in-memory\n/// caches.\n///\n/// This is called once at startup. Existing in-memory contents are cleared and\n/// replaced by the persisted state.\npub fn load_storage(\n    sessions: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, CombatSession>,\n    users: &mut std::collections::HashMap<String, User>,\n) -> Result<(), String> {\n    users.clear();\n    sessions.clear();\n\n    let users_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT username, role, password_hash FROM users;\")?;\n    let users_content = extract_top_array_content(&users_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(users_content) {\n        let username = extract_string(obj, \"username\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing username\")?\n            .to_string();\n        let role = extract_string(obj, \"role\").ok_or(\"missing role\")?.to_string();\n        let password_hash = extract_string(obj, \"password_hash\")\n            .ok_or(\"missing password_hash\")?\n            .to_string();\n        users.insert(\n            username.clone(),\n            User {\n                username,\n                role,\n                password_hash,\n            },\n        );\n    }\n\n    let sessions_output = sqlite_query(\"SELECT id, round, turn_index FROM combat_sessions;\")?;\n    let sessions_content = extract_top_array_content(&sessions_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    for obj in extract_objects(sessions_content) {\n        let id = extract_string(obj, \"id\").ok_or(\"missing id\")?.to_string();\n        let round = extract_int(obj, \"round\").ok_or(\"missing round\")?;\n        let turn_index = extract_int(obj, \"turn_index\").ok_or(\"missing turn_index\")? as usize;\n\n        let c_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT name, score, dex, position FROM combatants WHERE session_id = '{}' ORDER BY position;\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let c_output = sqlite_query(&c_sql)?;\n        let c_content = extract_top_array_content(&c_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut order = Vec::new();\n        for c_obj in extract_objects(c_content) {\n            let name = extract_string(c_obj, \"name\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing combatant name\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let score = extract_int(c_obj, \"score\").ok_or(\"missing score\")?;\n            let dex = extract_int(c_obj, \"dex\").ok_or(\"missing dex\")?;\n            order.push(crate::domain::Combatant { name, score, dex });\n        }\n\n        let cond_sql = format!(\n            \"SELECT target, condition, remaining FROM conditions WHERE session_id = '{}';\",\n            sql_escape(&id)\n        );\n        let cond_output = sqlite_query(&cond_sql)?;\n        let cond_content = extract_top_array_content(&cond_output).unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let mut conditions = std::collections::HashMap::new();\n        for cond_obj in extract_objects(cond_content) {\n            let target = extract_string(cond_obj, \"target\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing target\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let name = extract_string(cond_obj, \"condition\")\n                .ok_or(\"missing condition\")?\n                .to_string();\n            let remaining = extract_int(cond_obj, \"remaining\").ok_or(\"missing remaining\")?;\n            conditions\n                .entry(target)\n                .or_insert_with(Vec::new)\n                .push(crate::domain::Condition { name, remaining });\n        }\n\n        sessions.insert(\n            id.clone(),\n            CombatSession {\n                id,\n                round,\n                turn_index,\n let wis = extract_int(abilities, \"wis\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n    let cha = extract_int(abilities, \"cha\").ok_or(PlayError::BadRequest)?;\n\n    if !valid_race(&race) || !valid_class(&class) || !valid_background(&background) {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n    if str < 1 || str > 30\n        || dex < 1 || dex > 30\n        || con < 1 || con > 30\n        || int < 1 || int > 30\n        || wis < 1 || wis > 30\n        || cha < 1 || cha > 30\n    {\n        return Err(PlayError::BadRequest);\n    }\n\n    let level = 1;\n    let con_modifier   body: &str,\n    actor: &str,\n) -> Result<String, PlayError> {\n    if !play_campaign_exists(campaign_id).map_err(|_| PlayError::BadRequest)? {\n        return Err(PlayError::NotFound);\n    }\n dex,\n        \"con\" => con,\n        \"int\" => int,\n        \"wis\" => wis,\n        \"cha\" => cha,\n        _ => return Err(PlayError::BadRequest),\n    };\n    if ability_score < 1 || \"cha\")\n}\n\n/// Level up a campaign character by one.\n///\n/// POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/characters/{char_id}/level-up\n///\n/// Only the character's owner may call this endpoint. It uses Rust\n1.97.0 and the standard library only: no external crates, no serde, no HTTP\nframework. The server binds to `127.0.0.1`\non the port given by the `PORT` environment variable (default `8080`). This serializes requests and keeps the\nin-memory view consistent with the database between `save_storage` calls.\n\n### Persistence\n\nPersistence is implemented in `src/store.rs` by invoking the `sqlite3` command\nline tool. The dispatcher uses a\nmethod-based split (`dispatch_get`, `dispatch_post`, `dispatch_put`,\n`dispatch_delete`) plus helper parsers for dynamic path segments:\n\n- `combat::parse_combat_path` for `/v1/combat/sessions/{id}/...`\n- `campaigns::parse_campaign_path` for `/v1/campaigns/{id}/...`\n- `campaigns::parse_campaign_session_path` for session attendance paths.\n- `quests::parse_campaign_quest_path` and `parse_quest_progress_path`.\n- `inventory::parse_campaign_inventory_path`, `parse_inventory_summary_path`,\n  and `parse_character_equipment_path`.\n- `downtime::parse_crafting_path` and `parse_crafting_advance_path`.\n- `play::parse_play_campaign_path` for `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/...`.\n- `play::parse_play_campaign_scene_path`, `parse_play_campaign_location_path`,\n  and `parse_play_campaign_character_path` for nested play resources.\n- `play::parse_play_encounter_*` helpers for encounter-related routes.\n- `strip_prefix` for `/v1/compendium/monsters/{slug}` and items.\n\nAuthorization is enforced by `require_auth` in `src/main.rs`, which checks the\n`Authorization: Bearer session-{username}` header and verifies the registered\nrole (`dm`, `player`, or any role). All keyed extractors build on\n`find_value_pos`, which locates the first `\"key\"` and the following colon, and\n`scan_bracket_content`, which extracts balanced bracket bodies. The public\nhelpers are:\n\n- `extract_string` / `extract_int` / `extract_bool` — scalar fields.\n- `extract_array_content` / `extract_object_content` — nested bodies.\n- `extract_top_array_content` —
